propositions: _paged_search loops unbounded when a server ignores startAt offsets and re-serves the same non-empty page, advancing local state but receiving no new results
get_parent_map and three fetch_snapshot enrichment handlers swallow stall errors via broad except-Exception handlers, converting loud abort signals into silent degraded snapshots

DC pagination differs fundamentally from Cloud and fetcher siblings: short pages are the normal case on DC due to jira.search.views.default.max, so adopting short-page branches would silently truncate results by 92%
Stall detection requires tracking the previous page's first issue key and raising on any repeat, firing on the second call when the server is not advancing
Four fail-open sites must re-raise the stall error before broad exception handlers to ensure loud termination rather than degraded snapshot writes
